name: Honey Maid Original Graham Crackers
whyItWorks: Graham crackers use finely milled graham flour and real honey. They provide gentle complex carbohydrates and melt into a soft porridge when dipped in warm tea, water, or lactose-free milk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Break along the perforated lines into 4 rectangles. Dunk in warm peppermint or chamomile tea for an ultra-soothing stomach comfort snack.
watchOuts: Contains mild wheat bran; chew thoroughly.
